name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall facing a Smith machine bar set near mid-thigh height with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar shoulder-width overhand.
Unrack the bar, soften your knees slightly, and brace your core with your shoulder blades drawn back.
Push your hips smoothly backward while keeping the bar close to your thighs and shins until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward forcefully to return upright and squeeze your glutes at the top.
tips: Maintain a flat back and stop lowering as soon as your hips finish moving backward.
Keep your weight evenly grounded through your whole foot without letting your toes lift.
